name: Pine Labs Limited
summary: Pine Labs Ltd. provides payment solutions and point-of-sale systems to merchants, aiming to digitize commerce. Its work spans digital payments and issuing for merchants, consumer brands, enterprises and financial institutions, with products like Plutus, the myPlutus app, analytics and PaybyPoints. Three founders, Rajul Garg, Lokvir Kapoor and Tarun Upaday, started it in May 1998, and it is headquartered in Noida.
